meta.title: 생략구문
meta.note: 교재 p.53과 정답·해설 p.37의 대표 Q05~Q06 원문·정답 논리를 대조해 생략 복원 중심의 대표 source-aligned QA 세트로 변환함.

items.sentence: Most of our daily decisions do not involve existential decisions (such as a career choice), but things (like having tea or coffee, using our credit cards or paying cash, or other seemingly trivial decisions).
items.prompt: but things 앞뒤 구조에서 반복되어 생략된 동사 한 단어를 입력하세요.
items.explanation: 앞 절의 do not involve와 대비되어 but 뒤에는 Most of our daily decisions involve things ...라는 의미가 복원됩니다. 반복되는 involve가 생략되었습니다.
items.memory: but 뒤 명사구만 남으면 앞 절의 공통 동사를 복원

items.sentence: Most of our daily decisions do not involve existential decisions (such as a career choice), but things (like having tea or coffee, using our credit cards or paying cash, or other seemingly trivial decisions).
items.prompt: but 뒤를 생략 없이 복원한 의미로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
choices: but most of our daily decisions involve things like having tea or coffee
but things do not involve our daily decisions
items.answer: but most of our daily decisions involve things like having tea or coffee
items.explanation: but 뒤에는 앞의 주어 Most of our daily decisions와 동사 involve가 반복되므로 생략된 것으로 이해합니다.

items.sentence: Most of our daily decisions do not involve existential decisions (such as a career choice), but things (like having tea or coffee, using our credit cards or paying cash, or other seemingly trivial decisions).
items.prompt: seemingly ___ decisions의 문맥에 알맞은 말을 고르세요.
items.explanation: 차나 커피 선택, 카드나 현금 사용처럼 일상적이고 사소해 보이는 결정을 예로 들고 있으므로 trivial이 알맞습니다.

items.sentence: If an investigation is flawed in such a way that the results are open to plausible alternative interpretations, the findings cannot be admitted as evidence. It must be designed so that it is tight and its conclusions compelling.
items.prompt: its conclusions와 compelling 사이에서 생략된 be동사를 입력하세요.
items.explanation: so that 이하에서 it is tight와 its conclusions are compelling이 and로 병렬 연결됩니다. 두 번째 절의 are가 생략되었습니다.

items.sentence: If an investigation is flawed in such a way that the results are open to plausible alternative interpretations, the findings cannot be admitted as evidence. It must be designed so that it is tight and its conclusions compelling.
items.prompt: so that 이하의 병렬 구조를 올바르게 복원한 것을 고르세요.
choices: it is tight / its conclusions are compelling
it is tight / its conclusions is compelling
items.answer: it is tight / its conclusions are compelling
items.explanation: 첫 절의 보어 tight와 둘째 절의 보어 compelling이 대응하며, 복수 주어 its conclusions에는 are가 필요합니다.
